## Change

Describe the concrete user or repository behaviour and why the change belongs to Experiment Ledger.

## Evidence

Give the exact public entry points exercised and their results. State the maintained language and documentation parity, installed supplier provenance, resource scope and any unresolved qualification.

## Review

Confirm that the change preserves the storage/Common boundary, original evidence, privacy and licence obligations. Explain any migration and recovery implications. Do not include private records, credentials or unsupported capability claims.
